summary: Keep only forms that communicate identity, relation or interaction; use spacing and proportion as the primary expressive tools.
objective: Removing decoration has not removed the cues needed to identify parts, interpret a value or discover an action.
intent_signals: Reduce visual clutter while retaining meaning
example_prompts: Explain a service graph with minimalist forms and clearly labeled connection states.

principles: Keep only forms that communicate identity, relation or interaction; use spacing and proportion as the primary expressive tools.
implementation: Reduce components to meaningful masses while preserving essential connections and selectable boundaries.
Choose a restrained palette and one clear lighting relationship; add contrast intentionally for focus and state.
Use a calm framing with room around the subject; animate only meaningful transitions or one deliberate ambient gesture.

Hold the working palette at three colours (#f4f2ee ground, #2b2b2b form, #d94f2b accent) and keep at least 55% of the frame as empty ground; the two reserve swatches stay unused unless a disabled or secondary state genuinely needs them.

Space objects at 1.5x their own width or more and chamfer every edge 2 mm; with key:fill at 1.8:1 and a single 12%-opacity contact ellipse, that chamfer highlight is the only separation cue the style allows.
observable_checks: Removing decoration has not removed the cues needed to identify parts, interpret a value or discover an action.

defaults.rationale: A minimalist scene has no texture, no fog and no second light to hide behind, so the numbers protect the two things that remain: emptiness and edge quality. The palette is deliberately three colours padded to five reserve slots, more than half the frame stays empty ground with no horizon seam, and a soft 1.8:1 key with Neutral tone mapping at 1.05 keeps the field even so the single accent and the 2 mm chamfer line carry the whole composition.

palette.role: ground and background, one continuous field
form and type, the only dark value
single accent, reserved for the active or selected element
unused / reserve - a second surface plane only if the three-colour set fails
unused / reserve - disabled state only, never part of the composition

values.value_structure: 70/22/8 light/mid/dark; at least 55% of the frame is empty ground containing no object, edge or shadow
values.saturation_rule: two achromatic values plus one accent at <= 70% HSL; the accent appears once per view and only on the interactive or currently selected element

lights.ratio: key:fill ~ 1.8:1, near shadowless; the cast shadow is one soft ellipse at 12% opacity and nothing else

values.intensity_unit: three-intensity (lux-scaled for Directional/Hemisphere, candela for Point/Spot; tuned with the stated tone_mapping.exposure)

materials.notes: one material for every surface; separation comes from spacing of 1.5x object width and from a 2 mm chamfer catching a single highlight line

values.signature_technique: one continuous ground-and-background field with no horizon seam, so the subject floats in value and every edge in frame belongs to the subject
never: a visible horizon line or backdrop seam
more than one accent element per view
removing units, legends or the cue that makes an action discoverable

known_limits: Values are authored starting points tuned for Neutral tone mapping at exposure 1.05; re-tune every intensity, fog density and bloom threshold if you change the tone mapping or exposure.
No renderer run for this record; values are authored starting points.
creative_affordances: Combine with geometric-abstract, monochrome or scientific encoding; minimalism must not delete units, uncertainty or required controls.
